$comment: Grandfathered .is-* state classes that pre-date docs/frontend/state-vocabulary.md. This list may only shrink — adding a new class fails review. Each entry will be migrated either to a vocabulary entry (.is-loading / .is-open / .is-active / .is-pressed / etc.) or out of the .is-* namespace entirely (BEM modifier or component-scoped class) in PR-gamma-2.

grandfathered.reason: messages thread own-message marker; rename to messages-view__message--self in PR-gamma-2.
Synonym of .is-open per vocab; rename in PR-gamma-2 with aria-expanded coverage.
Visual variant; move to BEM modifier (__composer--compact) in PR-gamma-2.
Two distinct usages: (1) optimistic-message awaiting server ack, (2) channel awaiting load. Both fold into .is-loading in PR-gamma-2.
Affordance, not state; collapse with the static-pair into a component-scoped class in PR-gamma-2.
Inverse of clickable affordance; replace with .is-disabled or component-scoped class in PR-gamma-2.
Synonym of .is-active per vocab; rename in PR-gamma-2.
Shell-level layout flag that drives feed padding offset; move to component-scoped class on the shell or feed root in PR-gamma-2 (it is not a per-element state).
Notification-target-unknown variant; component-scoped modifier in PR-gamma-2.
Toggle on a single button; rename to .is-pressed with aria-pressed in PR-gamma-2.
Domain status (verification revoked); component-scoped class in PR-gamma-2 (verification is the only thing that has a revoked state).
Visual variant (single image gallery); BEM modifier in PR-gamma-2.
Domain status; either fold into .is-disabled (with aria-disabled) or rename to component-scoped in PR-gamma-2.
Read-state; component-scoped modifier in PR-gamma-2 (read-state is owned by NodeBB and lives on the list item).
Inline confirmation flow; component-scoped class in PR-gamma-2.
Runner-location postponed marker; component-scoped class in PR-gamma-2.
